CustomField.description: DeveloperName of the email template the automatic Save Progress email uses when the submission has a Contact 1 to render it against; merge Save Progress Resume Link for the link. Without a Contact 1, or when no template matches, a built-in message with the link is sent. Also read by the Send Email flow on a Save Progress conversion event. Pairs with Send Save Progress Email.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Developer name of the email template for the Save Progress email. Used when the submission has a Contact 1; otherwise a built-in message is sent. Merge the Save Progress Resume Link field for the link.
CustomField.label: Email Template Name (Saved)
